title: Post-triggered turn on a busy Claude thread emits no turn.started
description: ClaudeAdapter.sendTurn (apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeAdapter.ts:4892) treats a sendTurn during a live non-synthetic turn as a steer: it reuses the existing turnId, emits no turn.started event, and offers the message onto the session promptQueue (line 5018). A channel post that wakes a mid-turn agent is therefore folded into the in-flight turn and has no turn of its own. If the channel UI wants one row per post, correlation must come from the post/mention entity, not turnId. Codex differs: CodexSessionRuntime.ts:2343 gets a distinct queued turn id back from turn/start but keeps activeTurnId pinned to the running turn. Found during t3_bot-c6z recon (Boss3).

title: Channel aggregate kind: add 'channel' to OrchestrationAggregateKind, widen aggregateId, make commandToAggregateRef exhaustive (no default)
Agent-originated turn dropped when thread is compacting
description: ProviderCommandReactor.ts:1521 queues thread.turn-start-requested events into turnsAfterCompaction while a thread compacts, and cancelTurnsAfterCompaction discards them on compaction failure with a human-facing 'Send this message again to continue.' message. A turn triggered by a channel post has no human to resend it, so the post is silently dropped. Needs a retry or dead-letter path before post-to-turn triggering ships. Found during t3_bot-c6z recon (Boss3).
